entries.0eda03be95f65257: This is a business based mainly in Japan that manufactures and sells building materials such as sashes for windows, entrance doors, shutters, gates, carports, and curtain walls, and also provides housing-related services including franchise chain development for local builders, construction contracting, and real estate management. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥518,432 million, a slight decrease from ¥521,002 million in the previous fiscal year. Against the backdrop of national subsidy programs for achieving a low-carbon society, renovation sales of highly insulated products, centered on windows, were firm, while sales for new construction were weak due to sluggish housing starts. Construction projects are made to order.
entries.1cda1efcbf970a33: This field covers the development of franchise chains for local builders, construction contracting, property management, and support for the development of franchise chains in the real estate business.
entries.1f9ea82ba6e715c0: This is a mainly domestic business that manufactures and sells system kitchens, sectional kitchens, vanities, washstand counters, and interior building materials such as interior doors and sliding doors, interior windows, flooring, staircases and storage. It became a new reportable segment from the fiscal year ended March 2026. It was formed by integrating the kitchen and washroom business of the former Water Technology Business and the interior business of the Housing Technology Business, which were considered to have many similarities in products, manufacturing processes and business models. Revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥183,430 million, slightly up from ¥181,109 million in the prior year, restated under the revised classification. Sales for renovation remained solid, and kitchen sales for new construction also stayed strong.

entries.5689bba9c3211e5f: This business manufactures and sells water-related equipment, including sanitary ware, shower toilets, faucet fittings, bathtubs, and unit baths, as well as exterior and interior tiles for housing and buildings. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥808,842 million, the largest of the three reportable segments, and a slight increase from ¥802,586 million in the previous fiscal year. In Japan, sales to renovation markets for sanitary ware and bathroom products were firm, and revenue increased. Overseas, in Europe, sales improved in most product categories, including faucet fittings, and unit sales increased; demand also continued in the Middle East and India. In the United States, revenue fell due to the previous year's transfer of the bathtub business and a delayed recovery in the renovation market, and in China, a slump in the property market compounded these factors, so overseas as a whole was roughly flat. European subsidiaries, including Grohe AG in Germany, are also included in this business.
